design: Compile a fail-fast collection loop from the same row expression. Lazy internal prototype; full canonical mapping retains per-row diagnostics, provenance and cancellation.
measurement: 18 fresh processes, three counterbalanced repeats of batch, scalar and AutoMapper at 1024 rows; four warmups, six 200ms iterations; identical frozen runtime.
outcome: Rejected after 42-case Linux CI. Local gains did not generalize; production prototype removed. Retained scalar implementation is a62aca11.
reproduction: Checkout d7fb02a4 for the CI benchmark, or apply rejected-collection-prototype.tar.gz prototype.patch to a62aca11 (includes the later allocation test).
